title: Technology Sector Update for 10/17/2018: IBM,LRCX,BLIN
text:

Technology stocks were somewhat softer in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing about 0.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising less than 0.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) IBM ( IBM ) Wednesday slid to its lowest price since February 2016, dropping at one point more than 8%, after the IT services company recorded a 2% drop in Q3 revenue from year-ago levels to $18.76, trailing the Capital IQ consensus of $19.04 billion. Non-GAAP earnings totaled $3.42 per share during the July-to-September reporting period, beating the Street forecast of $3.40 per share.
In other sector news:
(+) Lam Research ( LRCX ) was ahead by about 2% in recent trading, giving back more than half of a nearly 6% advance earlier in Wednesday trading after beating Wall Street expectations with its Q3 financial results and guiding its Q4 net income above analyst estimates.
(-) Bridgeline Digital ( BLIN ) plunged nearly 33% on Wednesday to a worst-ever 47 cents a share after the marketing automation company priced a $5 million public offering of 10 million shares of its common stock at 50 cents apiece, a 28% discount to Tuesday's closing price for the company's stock. Investors participating in the offering also received one five-year warrant to buy additional share, also at 50 cents a share. The company expects to use the net proceeds to repay some of its term notes and funding general corporate activities.
